output.interpretation: A vendor API notice (fieldco-api-notice) states the field-dispatch v2 route endpoint was retired on 2026-10-01 and route pushes must now use v3. This is a technical integration detail about how the push_route_update action must be invoked; it says nothing about dispute causation, staffing, AMI reads, or billing errors.

contradiction_assessment.rationale: The root problem (dispute surge causation) is unaffected; this only means any future execution of the push_route_update protected action on field-dispatch must target the v3 endpoint instead of the retired v2 one. push_route_update is already excluded from current release scope, so this has no immediate effect.

vob_proposals.unresolved_question: If push_route_update on field-dispatch is ever executed, does the current field-dispatch integration/tooling support the v3 endpoint now that v2 is retired?
vob_proposals.validation_method: Verify field-dispatch tool/integration configuration targets the v3 route endpoint before any push_route_update call is attempted.
required_evidence: Confirmation that field-dispatch client/integration uses v3 endpoint
vob_proposals.rationale: push_route_update is a protected action requiring Field Operations Manager confirmation (K-DISPATCH); using the retired v2 endpoint would cause the action to fail or behave unpredictably.
